headline: HOUTHIS 🍌 SEIZE 🚢 Red Sea PORT 🍑 of Mokha
text:
YEMEN'S 🏜️ HOUTHIS 🧨 have straight up SEIZED 🫳 the strategic 🌊 RED SEA 🩸 port city 🏙️ of MOKHA 🏖️ from those SAUDI-BACKED 🇸🇦 pro-government forces 🪖 military sources 🕵️ and witnesses 👀 say 📣 the IRAN-BACKED 🇮🇷 group 🕹️ claimed they pose ZERO 🚫 threat ☠️ to international shipping 🚢 but they REITERATED 🔁 they would TARGET 🎯 vessels ⛴️ from SAUDI ARABIA 🐪 which has relied on the RED SEA 🌊 for oil exports 🛢️ since the US 🇺🇸 and ISRAEL'S 🇮🇱 war 🔥 with IRAN 🇮🇷 effectively CLOSED 🔒 the STRAIT OF HORMUZ 🧭 in the GULF 🌊 footage 📹 from HOUTHI-RUN 📺 AL MASIRAH TV 📡 purportedly showed 🕵️ HOUTHI FIGHTERS 🧔 in MOKHA 🏘️ bro these guys are built different 🏗️ edging the whole coast like it's their side chick 😏

ON FRIDAY 📅 pro-government forces 🏳️ also WITHDREW 🏃 from PERIM ISLAND 🏝️ in the BAB AL-MANDAB STRAIT 🛤️ according to officials 👔 witnesses 👀 reported that HOUTHI FORCES 🪖 moved onto the island 🦶 the strait is the southern gateway 🚪 to a KEY SHIPPING ROUTE 🚚 that links ASIA 🌏 and EUROPE 🇪🇺 via the RED SEA 🌊 and SUEZ CANAL 🚢 oil 🛢️ hits 💥 one hundred dollars 💵 a barrel 🛢️ for first time since JULY 🌞 after US 🇺🇸 and HOUTHI strikes ⚔️ this escalation 🔥 between the HOUTHIS 🧨 YEMEN'S GOVERNMENT 🏛️ and SAUDI ARABIA 🐪 has contributed to a SURGE 📈 in oil prices 🤑 hundreds of people 🧍 have reportedly been KILLED ☠️ and thousands displaced 🏃‍♂️ since the HOUTHIS 🧨 launched an offensive 🗡️ in the south-west a week ago 🗓️ Saudi-led coalition 🪖 has also carried out air strikes ✈️ on HOUTHI-CONTROLLED areas 🏚️ in western YEMEN 🏜️ in support of the pro-government forces 🛡️ and the HOUTHIS 🧨 have launched missiles 🚀 and drones 🛰️ at cities 🏙️ and oil facilities 🛢️ in southern SAUDI ARABIA 🐪 MOKHA residents 🏠 said HOUTHI FIGHTERS 🧔 moved into the city 🏃 after fierce clashes ⚔️ with pro-government forces 🏳️ on Wednesday night 🌙 prompting many families 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 to flee their homes 🏃‍♀️ the takeover came without warning 🚨 panic spread 😱 throughout the area forcing people to flee 🏃 amid distressing scenes 😢 of injured people 🩹 lying in the streets 🛣️ with no one there to help them 🆘 one man told BBC ARABIC 📻 this is WILD 🐺 Saudi Daddy's proxies just got railed 💦 and sent packing 🧳

ANOTHER MAN 🧔 said that HOUTHI FIGHTERS 🧨 were patrolling the streets 🚶‍♂️ of MOKHA 🏘️ on Thursday 📆 while government offices 🏢 and shops 🛍️ were CLOSED 🔒 at the moment we don't know what ANSAR ALLAH 🙏 will do he added using the group's formal name 📛 everyone is afraid 😨 for their safety 🛡️ many displaced families 👪 are heading east ➡️ towards the city of ADEN 🏙️ where YEMEN'S internationally recognised PRESIDENTIAL LEADERSHIP COUNCIL 🪑 and government are based 🏛️ we fled with our children 🏃‍♀️ and kept running 🏃 we have no bedding 🛏️ no home 🏚️ nothing with us everything was destroyed within an hour 💥 they didn't even give us a chance or warn us beforehand 🚫 we are women with no means of defending ourselves 🛡️ and we have innocent children with us 👶 there was no immediate confirmation ✅ of MOKHA'S capture from the HOUTHIS 🧨 but the group's SUPREME POLITICAL COUNCIL 🏛️ said in a statement 📜 on Thursday 📆 that clashes had ceased in the western coast districts after the expulsion of SAUDI ENEMY mobilisations 🇸🇦 according to HOUTHI-RUN 📺 AL MASIRAH TV 📡 TAREK SALAH 🧔 leader of the pro-government NATIONAL RESISTANCE FORCES 🛡️ also said he had moved his command centre 🪖 on the west coast to a safe location 🏠 he added that his forces had paid a heavy price 🪦 in recent days in the face of a HOUTHI OFFENSIVE 🗡️ that was planned and supported by IRAN 🇮🇷 these poor dudes got absolutely COOKED 🍳 by the Houthi Daddy long dong offensive 🐉

A YEMENI MILITARY SOURCE 🪖 told AFP news agency 📰 that HOUTHI FIGHTERS 🧨 had also seized ZUQAR ISLAND 🏝️ in the RED SEA 🌊 about eighty kilometers northwest of MOKHA 🧭 after launching a barrage of rockets 🚀 and a ground assault using boats ⛴️ on Friday 📅 boats carrying HOUTHI FIGHTERS 🧨 reached the island of PERIM 🏝️ also known as MAYYUN 🏷️ after government forces withdrew 🏳️ a local government official told AFP 🗣️ they said the HOUTHIS 🧨 have completed their takeover of the BAB AL-MANDAB area 🛤️ and MAYYUN ISLAND 🏝️ which is located in the middle of the strait 🌊 meanwhile the head of the PRESIDENTIAL LEADERSHIP COUNCIL 👔 RASHAD AL-ALIMI 🧔 urged Arab states 🌍 and other countries to help protect YEMEN'S coasts 🏖️ and restore state control 🏛️ the HOUTHIS SUPREME POLITICAL COUNCIL 🏛️ asserted its right to defend YEMEN'S sovereignty 🛡️ and territorial waters 🌊 while simultaneously reassuring the international community 🌐 that navigation in the RED SEA 🌊 remains safe 🛟 however the HOUTHI-RUN humanitarian operations co-ordination centre 🆘 also stressed that the embargo on SAUDI SHIPS 🚢 remained in place 🔒 HOUTHI MILITARY SPOKESMAN 🗣️ YAHYA SAREA 🧔 said on Thursday 📆 that SAUDI WARPLANES ✈️ had carried out sixty four strikes 💥 across the western provinces of TAIZ 🏙️ HUDAYDAH 🏘️ MARIB 🏜️ and JAWF 🏔️ over the previous twenty four hours ⏰ there was no immediate comment from the SAUDI MILITARY 🇸🇦

HOWEVER THE SPOKESMAN 🗣️ of the SAUDI-LED COALITION 🐪 of Arab states fighting in YEMEN 🏜️ said on Wednesday evening 🌆 that it would respond to a series of HOUTHI MISSILE 🚀 and DRONE 🛰️ attacks on the south-western SAUDI CITIES 🏙️ of KHAMIS MUSHAIT 🏘️ ABHA 🏔️ and JAZAN 🌴 on Tuesday 📅 the HOUTHIS 🧨 launched dozens of drones 🛰️ and missiles 🚀 at southern SAUDI ARABIA 🐪 injuring seventy three civilians 🤕 and causing fires 🔥 at several oil facilities 🛢️ that led to a temporary halt in operations 🛑 according to SAUDI AUTHORITIES 👔 the HOUTHIS 🧨 said they were retaliating for dozens of SAUDI AIR STRIKES ✈️ on territory they control in recent days including one on a prison 🏰 in the town of HAZM 🏘️ in JAWF PROVINCE 🏔️ on Monday 📆 that they said killed at least twenty three civilians ☠️ the SAUDI-LED COALITION 🐪 has backed YEMEN'S GOVERNMENT 🏛️ against the HOUTHIS 🧨 in the country's devastating civil war 💥 for more than a decade 📅 a four-year-old informal ceasefire 🤝 began to unravel in JULY 🌞 when the HOUTHIS 🧨 announced a maritime embargo 🚫 against SAUDI ARABIA 🐪 and began missile 🚀 and drone 🛰️ attacks on SAUDI AIRPORTS 🛫 oil facilities 🛢️ and tankers ⛴️ in the RED SEA 🌊 the HOUTHIS 🧨 said they were retaliating for a SAUDI BLOCKADE 🚫 of ports and airports in their territory as well as an air strike ✈️ on SANAA AIRPORT 🛫 that they blamed on the kingdom 👑 these desert daddies been edging each other for years and now the whole sea getting railed 💦
